data_sources: Phase 4 entity classification artifact (used to exclude confirmed LIQUIDITY_POOL from wallet-level SPR-02)
Phase 5 creator/related-wallet artifact (only where evaluator uses supported fields)
limitations: No market-wide trading-volume completeness is assumed.
Token transfers are not treated as buys or sells.
Transfer→SELL temporal association does not prove token-flow causality.
No aggregate risk score is calculated.
A missing input is not interpreted as absence of risk.
